subject: general
question: Which of the following is a characteristic of a plant cell?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cell wall is present.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Cell wall:-**

 
 
• It is a rigid structure that surrounds the cell membrane and provides support and protection to the cell.
 
• The central vacuole in plant cells is large and occupies most of the cell's volume, unlike the small vacuoles found in animal cells. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chloroplasts:-**

 
 
• These are present in plant cells, which are responsible for the process of photosynthesis.
 
• They contain chlorophyll, a pigment that absorbs sunlight and converts it into energy.
 
 
 
• **Plastids:-**
 
 
• These are a group of organelles found in plant cells that have diverse functions such as storage, pigmentation, and photosynthesis.
 
• Chloroplasts are a type of plastid that contains chlorophyll.
